# NNNN — Decision title, as a statement

- **Status:** Proposed — settled by PN-NN / @handle | Accepted | Superseded by NNNN | Rejected
- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Decided by:** @handle   <!-- or "Proposed by" while Proposed -->
- **Supersedes:** NNNN   <!-- delete if none -->

## Context

What question needed answering, and the facts that constrain it (mods API
limits, earlier decisions, user requests). Link docs.

## Options

1. **Option A** — trade-offs.
2. **Option B** — trade-offs.

## Decision

What we do, stated so a contributor can follow it without asking. Numbers and
names exactly.

## Consequences

What this makes easier or harder, and what has to change (docs, tasks, code).
